name: mika
title: Mika
subject: An original anime girl cut at the waist, the portrait a mobile game shows in dialogue and menus: twin tails, sailor collar, a face rig with lids, brows and mouth shapes, and a right arm that can wave.
intent: A dialogue portrait that is never frozen. She breathes and blinks, reacts with a short lead-in clip and a loop for each emotion, waves, and goes back to idle; the hair always arrives after the head that moves it.

clips.name: idle
clips.does: breath with a short top hold, a blink, the head drifts and the tails, locks and strand trail it

clips.name: happy_in
clips.does: a blink and a dip, then a snap up past the pose into a smile; the tails follow two and three frames late

clips.name: happy
clips.does: a light bounce with a held beat, the head rocks out of step, the tails swing behind

clips.name: surprised_in
clips.does: a startled blink and a dip, then up with wide eyes, small pupils, raised brows and an open mouth

clips.name: surprised
clips.does: the surprise held alive: the body rises and settles, the eyes stay wide, the hair keeps moving

clips.name: wave
clips.does: a small backswing, the arm swings up with an overshoot, three waves with the hand flapping late, and down

clips.name: to_idle
clips.does: a blink covers the change, everything settles back to the rest pose
